description: This file defines the FileData class used for representing file information such as filename, content type, and data source within the Apache Fineract document management infrastructure.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: A data container class for storing file-related information including filename, content type, and byte source.

methods.name: FileData
methods.description: Constructor for initializing FileData with a ByteSource, filename, and content type.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the file.

methods.name: getByteSource
methods.description: Provides access to the ByteSource representing the file content.
